description: Pool-plan channel map (2026-11-19, no thruster, no loopback). The Windows PC plays through the USB interface (out1 -> amplifier) and records nothing; the two Daisy Seed boards record the four hydrophones at 96 kHz / 24-bit on the Linux capture machine (scripts/record_daisy.py; run_session.py daisy-cmds prints the command lines), and every recorder aligns on the chirps its hydrophones hear. File channels are 0-based. Hydrophone channel_id is the ch<N> of every utt_id; ch0 is scored. Edit to match the rig on the day (run_session.py plan copies it into session.json).

iface.note: USB playback interface, out1 -> amplifier; plays only (no inputs recorded, no loopback)

daisyA.note: Daisy Seed A, record_daisy.py on the Linux capture machine

daisyB.note: Daisy Seed B, record_daisy.py on the Linux capture machine
